benchmarks.title: Artificial Analysis AA-WER v2
benchmarks.description: Independent English batch recognition across roughly eight hours: AA-AgentTalk (50%), VoxPopuli-Cleaned-AA (25%), and Earnings22-Cleaned-AA (25%). WER is duration-weighted within each dataset. Speed includes network time and uses ten-minute audio trials.
benchmarks.limitations: A source snapshot, not a Cantrip run. Their Whisper-based number, spelling, contraction, and filler normalization differs from Cantrip's ASCII scorer. Ten-minute throughput is not short-dictation latency. Fish Transcribe 1 Pro is not listed in this source; no independent score is invented. Parakeet v2 below is not Cantrip's local v3 model.

benchmarks.title: Microsoft's FLEURS report
benchmarks.description: Microsoft's September 3, 2026 announcement reports MAI-Transcribe-2 averaging 5.2% WER on FLEURS across 60 languages.
benchmarks.limitations: Vendor-reported multilingual result, not an independent replication or English dictation score. The announcement does not provide enough per-language protocol detail to reproduce the aggregate here. The advertised $0.10 per audio hour is promotional through December 31, 2026, not a perpetual price.
